items.title: 16.3 Chemicals ke fuzle ko thikane lagane ka nizam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.3, printed page 338.

blocks.text: Chemical waste (fuzla) koore ke dabbon ya sewer system mein nahi phenka ja sakta. Zyada tar chemical waste ko Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) ke in qawaid (rules) ke mutabiq thikane lagaya jata hai:

items: Chemical waste ko munasib (proper) containers mein rakhein.
Containers par label lagayein: waste ki qism, waste ki tareekh aur woh jagah jahan se aaya (place of origin).
Phir yeh containers muqarrar jagah (allocated site) par le jaye jate hain jahan inhen theek tareeqe se treat kar ke thikane lagaya jata hai.
Waste ke chemical treatment mein neutralization, precipitation, ion exchange, oxidation ya reduction shamil hain.

blocks.caption: Waste ke chemical treatments
rows: acid ya alkali waste ko mehfooz pH par laya jata hai
ghule hue nuqsan-deh ions ko na-ghulne wala (insoluble) bana kar alag kiya jata hai
nuqsan-deh ions resin par pakar liye jate hain
nuqsan-deh madde ko kam nuqsan-deh madde mein badla jata hai

blocks.prompt: Chemical waste kaise thikane lagaya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Dabbe ya sewer mein kabhi nahi. Ise munasib containers mein rakhte hain, waste ki qism, tareekh aur jagah ka label lagate hain, aur muqarrar jagah le ja kar neutralization, precipitation, ion exchange, oxidation ya reduction se treat karte hain.

items: Chemical waste: dabbe ya sewer mein nahi (EPA ke qawaid).
Containers mein rakhein, label lagayein (qism, tareekh, jagah), muqarrar jagah bhejein.
Treatment: neutralization, precipitation, ion exchange, oxidation ya reduction.
